scientific_decision_basis: MECAI pre-formal approval; no LLM responses or target-fault behavior used

variables.selection: none; every variable is represented identically

normal_reference.fit_scope: all FaultFree Training rows and all 52 X variables only

normalization.mean: arithmetic mean over all 250000 FaultFree Training rows
normalization.scale: sample standard deviation over all 250000 FaultFree Training rows with ddof=1

window.duration_note: The approved 60-minute duration is 20 observations at a 3-minute cadence; the difference between the first and last sample timestamps is 19 intervals, or 57 minutes.
window.ordering: group by blind_run_id, sort each run by sample ascending, then emit complete windows at zero-based row starts 0, 5, 10, ...
window.window_id: zero-based emission index within each blind_run_id; retained only in the internal scientific record

top_level_fields.representation: representation identifier from the run configuration
top_level_fields.variables: ordered array containing exactly one symmetric summary object for each of the 52 variables

internal_record_only.simulation_run_blind_id: opaque run identifier used for logs, checkpoints, association, evaluation and audit
internal_record_only.window_id: zero-based window sequence number within the blind run
internal_record_only.sample_start: absolute source sample index of the first observation
internal_record_only.sample_end: absolute source sample index of the evaluation point

per_variable_fields.variable: anonymized identifier from the fixed 52-variable ordered set
per_variable_fields.start_z: first standardized value in the causal window
per_variable_fields.end_z: last standardized value in the causal window
per_variable_fields.mean_z: arithmetic mean of the 20 standardized values
per_variable_fields.slope_z_per_sample: ordinary least-squares linear slope of standardized value on positions 0..19, in z units per sample

payload.numeric_rounding: each per-variable numeric statistic is converted to float and rounded with Python round(value, 4)

information_delivered_in_addition_to_pay: the summary is standardized against a normal reference
the allowed states are NORMAL, EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT, and ANOMALY
the model must not infer a named fault
evidence may cite only payload variable identifiers
each evidence item must use one structured claim from HIGH, LOW, INCREASE, REDUCTION, VARIABILITY
the response must conform to the JSON schema and confidence must be null

withheld_information: DPCA, T2, SPE/Q or any detector output
future samples outside the causal window
window_id, sample_start, sample_end, or any absolute position within the run
TEP, Tennessee Eastman, IDV, fault identity, process topology, or variable semantics

guarantees.all_52_variables: X_COLUMNS is a fixed 52-element list; build_payload iterates the entire list without filtering
guarantees.symmetric_representation: the same seven fields and the same formulas are applied to every X variable
guarantees.no_target_fault_selection: no target-fault values, labels, statistics, responses or detection results participated in this contract
guarantees.leakage_guard: validate_llm_payload rejects run identifiers, absolute temporal keys, prohibited labels and target/DPCA text patterns before prompt rendering
guarantees.opaque_blinding: simulationRun is replaced internally by a deterministic opaque blind ID for logs and checkpoints; neither source nor blind run identifier is delivered to the LLM

implementation_alignment.enforcement_note: window and stride are frozen in formal.json; the derived confirmation refresh is validated as ceil(window_samples / stride_samples) and is not part of the LLM payload
